note: Lifted semantic model, Summit (packet-core) side. Home-grown, no standard vocabulary. Summit and the RAN OSS touch only at the user-plane transport seam. Concepts carry a bespoke label, synonyms, a kind, a gloss, an example, the ad-hoc reference entry bound to (ref; native-only concepts bind to a native-gap ref), relations, and instances. Carries the surface partner of the 'session' trap (pdu-session near rrc-session) and one opaque tag. ref=null marks an opaque item.

concepts.label: n3-transport
concepts.gloss: the user-plane transport between the access site and the core user-plane function; the underlay that carries the core's data sessions
concepts.example: the N3 transport from the core edge down to site NR-441

concepts.label: upf-transport-endpoint
concepts.gloss: the user-plane function's endpoint where the N3 transport terminates in the core; the demarcation toward the access
concepts.example: the UPF N3 endpoint serving site NR-441

concepts.label: n3-dscp
concepts.gloss: the DiffServ marking the core sets on user-plane packets, mapped from the session's QoS, for the transport to honour
concepts.example: EF set for a voice flow's packets on n3-441

concepts.label: n3-capacity
concepts.gloss: the transport capacity the core requires on the N3 for the sessions it places at a site
concepts.example: 8 Gbit/s required on n3-441 at the busy hour

concepts.label: n3-mtu
concepts.gloss: the MTU the core needs on the N3 to carry encapsulated user packets without fragmentation
concepts.example: 1600-byte MTU required on n3-441 for GTP encapsulation

concepts.label: qos-flow
concepts.gloss: a QoS flow within a data session, the finest granularity of core QoS — a core-internal object with no transport counterpart
concepts.example: the guaranteed-bit-rate flow for a voice call inside a session

concepts.label: pdu-session
concepts.gloss: a PDU session: a subscriber's end-to-end data connection through the core to a data network — a core-internal notion of a 'session', unrelated to a radio connection
concepts.example: the internet PDU session for a handset served at site NR-441
